description: Implement Micro-Batched Bronze Parquet Writer with Replay Finalizer

ParquetPartitionWriter.buffering: In-memory buffer with count (max_buffer_size=500) and time (max_buffer_seconds=30.0) flush triggers
ParquetPartitionWriter.serialization: Polars DataFrame normalized schema with UTC event_ts/ingest_ts and json-serialized payload/payload_json
ParquetPartitionWriter.finalizer: finalize_session() merges partitions into events.parquet with optional cleanup_partitions

replay_discovery.discover_replay_sessions: Discovers live sessions with events.parquet or part-*.parquet and sets label to [LIVE-RECORDED]
replay_discovery.ParquetReplaySource: Seamlessly streams events from either events.parquet or part-*.parquet in chronological order
